emails.subject: Welcome to the Gullah Geechee Library
emails.body: You now have access to our complete collection of Gullah Geechee books. Explore at your own pace and let the wisdom of the ancestors guide you.

emails.subject: Start with the Encyclopedia
emails.body: If you're new to our collection, we recommend starting with the Encyclopedia volumes. They provide the foundation for understanding Gullah Geechee culture and heritage.

emails.subject: Discover the How-To Guides
emails.body: Once you've explored the Encyclopedia, check out our practical guides on boundaries, self-care, confidence, and purpose. Real wisdom for real life.

emails.subject: Share the Legacy
emails.body: Knowledge grows when shared. Forward this library to someone who would benefit from the Gullah Geechee heritage. The ancestors are watching and approving.
